summary: Welltower OP LLC, a Welltower Inc. subsidiary, filed a prospectus supplement for a C$1.15 billion debt offering of two tranches of senior unsecured notes: C$750M 3.850% notes due 2031 and C$400M 4.150% notes due 2033. The notes are fully and unconditionally guaranteed by Welltower Inc. The offer price per note is 99.978% (2031) and 99.971% (2033). This is an ordinary debt issuance, not a special situation. No strategic event, takeover, or restructuring is involved; it is a routine capital markets transaction by a REIT.
